## PlaneCrash Info Example

```{r crashes}
year = 2025

crash_url = paste0('https://www.planecrashinfo.com/', year, '/', year, '.htm')

crash_page <- rvest::read_html(crash_url, encoding = "ISO-8859-1")

# This should now print without the error
crash_page
## {html_document}
## <html>
## [1] <head>\n<meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=UTF-8 ...
## [2] <body>\n<p align="center"><b><font face="Arial" color="#B0B6FF" size="5"> ...
# How many <table> elements are on the page?
crash_tables <- crash_page |>
  rvest::html_elements("table") |>
  rvest::html_table()

crash_df = crash_tables[[1]]

# from a cleaning perspective, there are several things that can be changed:
# [1] Replace the column names with the first row
# [2] Have better column types (e.g., Date being a date instead of character)
# [3] There are possible things you can do to clean the data within columns; e.g., split columns that contain multiple pieces of information
# column 4 has: fatalities/# passengers (ground fatalities)

# for today's class, we will focus on the first two

colnames(crash_df) = crash_df[1, ]

# then delete first row
crash_df = crash_df[-1, ]

crash_df = crash_df|> 
  # converts date into a date object
  dplyr::mutate(Date = lubridate::dmy(Date))
```

## Salvage Class Game
```{r game}
page = rvest::read_html("https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app/registry?start=1")
classes = page |>
  rvest::html_elements(".Dreadnought") |>
  rvest::html_text2()
length(classes)   # check this first: one per card

# from clicking on the site, we saw that our page changes by 50


base = "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app"
starts = seq(from = 1, to = 351, by = 50)
pages = vector("list", length(starts))
for (i in seq_along(starts)) {
  pg = rvest::read_html(paste0(base, "/registry?start=", starts[i]))
  pages[[i]] = data.frame(
    class = pg |> rvest::html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(1) > span") |>
      rvest::html_text2(),
    value = pg |> rvest::html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(3) > span") |>
      rvest::html_text() |>
      readr::parse_number()
  )
  Sys.sleep(1)   # robots.txt asks for it
}
registry = dplyr::bind_rows(pages)   # 400 rows?

registry |> dplyr::filter(class == "Dreadnought") |> 
  dplyr::mutate(value = as.numeric(value)) -> Dreadnoughts_df

sum(Dreadnoughts_df$value)
```

## Structured text extractions

### Course Information

```{r courses}
chat = ellmer::chat_openai(
  model = "gpt-5.6-luna", # note that the API key provided only works with 5.6 luna
  params = ellmer::params(reasoning_effort = "none")
)

isa125_text = rvest::read_html("https://bulletin.miamioh.edu/courses-instruction/isa/") |>
  # for this example, only the first course
  rvest::html_elements("#sc_sccoursedescs > div:nth-child(1) > p.courseblockdesc") |>
  rvest::html_text2()

course_info <- chat$chat_structured(
  isa125_text, 
  type = ellmer::type_object(
    name = ellmer::type_string(
      description = "Name of the course. For example, ISA 235. Information Technology and the Intelligent Enterprise. Do not include the parantheses for the credit hour and do not end with a period"
    ),
    description = ellmer::type_string(description = "The description of the course without the prereqs."),
    prereqs = ellmer::type_string("List the information after Prerequisite:")
  )
)
```

## all 50 courses
```{r}
chat = ellmer::chat_openai(
  model= "gpt-5.6-luna", 
  params = ellmer::params(reasoning_effort = "none")
)

course_list = rvest::read_html("https://bulletin.miamioh.edu/courses-instruction/isa/")|>
  rvest::html_elements(".courseblock")|>
  rvest::html_text2() |> # returns a chr vector
  as.list() # so as.list converts it to a list to match the example

type_course = ellmer::type_object(
  name = ellmer::type_string(
    description = "Name of the course. For example, ISA 235. Information technology and Interlligent Enterprise. Do not include the paranteses for the credit houe and do not end with a period"
  ), 
  credit_hours = ellmer::type_integer(
    description = "Return the credit hours that are listed nect to the course number and title in parantesis. Please do not include the paranteses in you response"),
  # renamed descriptopn in desc to amke it easier to see the descriptoion field from the element name (sublist neame)
  desc= ellmer::type_string(description = "The description of the course without the prereqs."),
  prereqs = ellmer::type_string("List the information after Prerequisity:")
  )

isa_df = ellmer::parallel_chat_structured(
  chat = chat, prompts = course_list, type = type_course, 
  include_tokens = T, include_cost = T
)


```
